balls.text: this is a half-volley that he was looking for, almost takes out the umpire's head with that hit
slower delivery, Bhuvi misses.. Sanju lobs it up to the bowler, but it's lobbed all the way over the bowler.. The batsmen were not looking for a bye, but they get it finally

What a comedy! The batsman misses the shot and runs out of the crease to pick up a bye.. Sanju fires the throw and misses.. Faulkner gathers the ball, he fires in a throw again as Mishra is still out of the crease.. He misses again.. Now Sanju takes it and he finally manages to strike the stumps.. Mishra could have saved himself but he had given himself up to the mercy of this funny game between Samson and Faulkner.. Irfan Pathan doesn't move, he had the best seat
superb yorker! But it's one of those times you are too good even for your own team.. Sanju is not able to dive and stop
and another one! This is too wide though but Irfan runs for a bye.. Steyn has to pay the price as Sanju takes down the stumps..
another legcutter, wide outside off, Irfan throws his bat at that, misses it again
slower delivery, Irfan charges out to launch it over cover, but ends up slicing it behind point
swings his bat, but he is cramped for room, only manages a limp shot to long on
length delivery angled across the batsman, Irfan swings to the leg side but misses it completely
looks to swing it to the leg side and gets an inside edge on to his body, picks up a single to short third man
good comeback from the bowler! He chases the batsman as he is making room and beats the bat swing
that is superbly played! He moves way towards the leg side and slives the full delivery over point
fuller delivery wide outside off, Irfan slices it to deep point.. just a single
cramps the batsman for room, he has no other option but to defend
fires in a quick yorker from round the stumps, the batsman gets a couple but it was only an inside edge to short fine leg
this time Irfan gets some bat on it, pushes it to backward point
another leg cutter and it spins past the outside edge..
a beautiful legcutter, it actually spins away from the batsman and beats the bat
he looks to play to leg side but gets a leading edge to cover
there is no first slip and that is exactly where Pathan gets this boundary from
he is keeping it on the stumps, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
another incoming delivery, Steyn pushes it straight to midwicket and sets off immediately.. The fielder from midwicket  fires in a throw at the non-striker's.. Was out had he hit
is there some reverse swing! Comes in a touch and Steyn drives it to mid-off
another one! This is a hat-trick for Watson. Angled delivery, it's steered straight to the hands of the keeper. Ahmedabad is proving real lucky for Royals! Second hat-trick in two games
he comes and picks up the wicket immediately! What a guy.. That was a length delivery, asking to be hit, Henriques clobbers it flat towards long-off where Rahane takes another good catch..
good wide yorker outside off, he chases it but can't make contact
this was on the pads and the batsman misses his flick, takes leg-bye to point
goes for the drive and gets a thick outside edge that drops a few meters short of the third man fielder
this one is not full enough but Irfan repeats the shot, misses again
this time he comes behind it and drives it smartly to deep extra cover
fires it full and wide outside off, Irfan doesn't get close to the line but tries to drive it, beaten
smashing shot! Henriques jumps out of the crease and whacks the length delivery straight past Irfan.. Powerful, precise
he comes forward and punches this length ball on the up to deep extra cover
short of length outside off, he steers it down to third man for a single
angled across the right-hander, beats the outside edge as the batsman looks to drive
looks for a single after dabbing this to cover point, but he is rightly sent back by Irfan
back of length but on the pads, it's clipped down to fine leg
goes back to the slider, defends it to midwicket
fuller delivery, driven straight to extra cover
another googly, but this is short enough for the batsman to punch to long off easily
bowls a googly, but this is going down the leg side.. the batsman goes for the pull but misses, gets hit on the pads
slides this one across the left-hander, who waits on the back foot before punching it to deep cover
pushed through on the midde stump line, the batsman brings his bat down just in time to punch it to long off
on the pads, easy pickings for Irfan as he flicks this one fine on the leg side
Bhatia downs another one! this is a slow legcutter on off, Naman Ojha tries to steer it fine on the off side and loses his offstump
slightly wider outside off, the batsman slices it straight to point
he moves to the leg side a touch before dabbing the length delivery to midwicket for a single
he comes forward and pushes the length delivery to cover
that's a hard chance for the keeper, who is standing up. The batsman looks to play a cute little cut but gets a faint edge.. It deflects off the gloves to short third man
pitches it up, Henriques pushes it down to long off for one
superbly done from Tambe, tosses it up more than he usually does, the line is on middle, Warner takes the bait and rushes out, has a swipe, but this is the googly, turns away, and he is stumped
drives a full delivery hard and it goes past extra cover to wide long off
pushed to extra cover
skips out, reaches the pitch and lifts it straight over the bowler, nothing desperate about the charge, and not hitting it too hard
tossed up full across the left-hander, driven to long off
slower on the pads, the batsman looks to flick and gets hit on the pads
he powers this down to long off for a single
almost hit back to the bowler! This was almost as slow as a Ramesh Powar delivery...85 kph!! The batsman looks to drive, but pushes it aerially past the bowler's left hand.. not too far
on the pads, Warner flicks it behind square leg for a single
back to normalcy.. he delivers a slower one on off, the batsman pushes it through cover for a single
short of length delivery at a quicker pace, Warner punches it down to long-off
he almost traps Warner with that one! The batsman sees the flight and goes for a slog sweep, but there is no pace on the delivery. The batsman got a thick top edge that landed safely at midwicket..
pushed through to the stumps, the batsman defends it to the leg side
shorter and flatter, an easy first one for Warner, he cracks it to deep cover
floated on the middle stump line, the batsman drives it to long off for a single
tossed up on off stump, the batsman waits as this is slow and pushes it to cover
the drift takes this one to the pads, Ojha clips it off his toes to deep backward square leg
tossed up but this way down the leg side

poor poor shot! Bhatia does what Bhatia does.. Slower delivery outside off, Rahul plays a sweep like he would have against a spinner, misses it completely and loses his offstump..What a shot to play after playing a number of good-looking straight-batted shots.. Sign of the tiimes
this is a low full toss and it's driven to wide long-off for a couple
he comes forward and punches this past the non-striker for a single
some room outside off, allows the batsman to punch it to deep cover for a single
on the pads at no-so-fast kph, the batsman punches it to long-on for a single
slower delivery outside off, the batsman moves to the leg side and drives it to deep cover
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman makes some room and drives it to deep cover
floated on the stumps, the batsman defends it to cover
flatter and shorter on the pads, the batsman punches it to deep midwicket
this is better, he comes forward and drives it down to long on
clever! Rahul chooses to play the reverse sweep to one pitched on leg-stump.. hit straight to short third man.. I say not so clever with that drift
tosses it right up, the batsman takes it on the full and drives it to long-on
slower, much slower, 93.7 kph, that is slower than Bhajji.. The batsman waits and punches it to deep cover for a single
back of length delivery on off, defended to point
he comes forward and punches the length delivery to long on

Rahane you beauty! He runs in from the deep midwicket boundary, dives forward and takes a blinder. This was a length ball and Finch, as is his wont, swung across the line but didn't make a great connection.. it looked like it was going to drop much short but Rahane ran in quick and slid under it.. A bit like Jadeja taking that catch to dismiss Allan Border in the 1992 WC
that has been powered to the wide long-on boundary! it was slow.. maybe a bit too slow.. it gave Finch enough time to go deep in the crease and whack it to the boundary
bowls his kind of ball just outside off, Rahul punches it to wide long-on off the back foot
just a single as Rahul comes forward and punches the length ball to the right of mid-off
starts moving towards the leg side and the bowler follows him from round the wicket line, the batsman glances but again, finds the man at short fine leg
stays on the back foot and steers the back of length delivery to third man
he comes forward and defends the angled delivery to point
drifting on to the pads and Finch just needed a deflection, but misses out as he gets hit on the thigh pad..picks up a leg bye to short fine leg
he comes round the wicket and bowls length on the stumps, the batsman defends it to midwicket
stays on the back foot and defends the length delivery close to the stumps
good solid front foot defence from Rahul to the length delivery
superb shot! He leans into this length delivery wide outside off and just times in the gap at cover.. No effort made to whack it hard, just a push
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it from the crease
beautiful timing from Rahul! It's full delivery outside off and Rahul just punches it down the ground.. Not great work by mid-on, who doesn't bend down in time
fires it full on the stumps, easy delivery for the batsman as he flicks it to deep square leg

he is got him! That has taken an outside edge from the offstump! Too close for a cut actually.. He was neither forward, nor backward.. A poor short from Dhawan just after he was starting to find his touch
back of length delivery on the middle, punched back to the bowler
short ball and on the leg side! Fine leg is up and it's not a very smart line with that field, Dhawan hooks it over the short fine fielder and gets four as the reward
this looked set for the boundary too, but the cut shot is saved by a diving Rahane at backward point
this is superb from Dhawan! Controlled shimmy down the pitch and punches it straight between the bowler and mid-off for a boundary
that leg side line is not going to help Royals but for now, it's ok.. Finch gets an inside edge to short fine leg and gets a single.. that could have been hit anywhere really
he offers a lot of width this time and Dhawan obliges by cracking it past a diving backward point to the boundary
now Finch looks for that gap at backward point but the short third-man dives and gets a hand to it to prevent the boundary
he is timing it beautifully! This one is punched to wide mid-off, but that made a nice sound of the bat
fires it full on the pads, Finch looks to flick it to square leg but gets an inside edge on to his pads, takes a single to the leg side
short delivery, Dhawan gets on top of that nicely as he pulls this along the ground to deep square leg
interesting! He walks out of the crease to punch his first delivery, gets an inside edge back towards the non-striker and the bowler is not able to bend down in time.. giving Finch his first run
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
he finds the gap at backward point! Dhawan opens the face of the bat really late to this offcutter and manages to bisect that tiny gap between short third man and backward point
he stays in the crease and punches the back of the length delivery to deep point for a couple
slower delivery, he gets an outside edge on it as he looks to run it down to third man, but that drops well short of Samson, the wicketkeeper
whoa! This is a typical Dhawan drive.. Just a checked push off a length ball and that burns the grass as it screeches to the cover boundary
pushes it fuller wide outside off, Dhawan doesn't go fully forward in his drive, gets an inside edge back to the bowler
he moves forward and pushes the length delivery to deep cover for a single
he comes forward for the first time, drives the fuller delivery straight to cover
this time he cracks it with a lot of power! Only a tiny bit of room there and he cashes on it, smacking it behind point and beats the deep point fielder
another tight delivery on off stump, Dhawan punches it straight to the gully fielder
length delivery on the stumps, now Dhawan gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler
he runs in to the din from the crowd and almost gets a wicket! Dhawan looks to punch this length delivery to off, but gets a thick inside edge past the stumps all the way to the boundary
Game over! Tambe chips the length delivery straight to Steyn at long-off
punches the fuller delivery, straight to Dhawan at cover again
moves to the leg side and crashes it ... the ball dribbles to cover..
another slower delivery, aerially driven through cover
length delivery at a slower pace from round the wicket, the batsman takes a single to point
slower delivery, Tambe pushes to mid-off and would have been run-out had the fielder hit.. He survives to live another over
back of length and rising, Kulkarni chops it down to third man for a single
quicker one attempted, but again down the leg side
looks for a slower ball but this is down the leg side
fuller and wider outside off, Kulkarni has to somehow get a thick outside edge, and he gets it, hitting it over point
length delivery on the middle stump line, the batsman gets his bat down in time to push it to cover
bowls it full outside off, the batsman slices it to deep point
fires in a yorker at Tambe, who somehow digs it out
slower ball, batsman swings, this time it doesn't even go beyond the square.. it goes high, touches the moon, but on its wayback, meets the bowler.. who was running backwards.. Superb catch again
fires in the yorker, the batsman digs it out to point for a single
length delivery on the stump, Kulkarni cuts it straight to point
full and wide outside off, the batsman drives it to deep cover to throw water on possible celebrations
slower delivery, Bhatia swings this time.. he goes towards deep midwicket.. again more height than distance.. Warner takes a simple catch

slower delivery, Faukner has no option but to swing at it, he hits in the right area, plays his natural game, but unfortunately it doesn't work for him today .. Finch comes round from long on to take a neat catch
he is bowling flatter here, another single to deep midwicket off the back foot
quicker and shorter on off, only a single to deep midwicket
he goes deep in the crease to pick up another single to long on
he stays in the crease and punches the length delivery to wide long off
flatter and shorter, the batsman punches it to long on
bowls it flat and gets some turn, the batsman chops it straight to cover point
fires it full on off stump, but it ends up being a low full toss and the batsman slices it past the diving Warner at point
length delivery on the legs, Bhatia pulls it down to fine leg with one hand

They are all on fire! Pathan completes an excellent catch.. With time running out, Smith looks for the big shot at this quick length delivery, he only manages a big top-edge. Irfan runs backwards from mid-off to settle under it
short of length and quick, this time Smith is beaten.. outside off
fires this on the leg stump, the batsman gets hit on the pads but picks up a leg bye
quick, very quick outside off, Bhatia looks to cut it but misses
comes out of the pitch early, but can only drive it to Dhawan at cover
he drags this from outside off to long-on for an easy single
he comes down the pitch and flicks the tossed up delivery to midwicket
slower and tossed up outside off, the batsman chops it straight to point
flatter and quicker outside off, punched back to the bowler
comes down the pitch and plays outside the line of this, gets hit on the pads but this was drifting down leg
length delivery on the stumps, Bhatia punches it back to the bowler
slower delivery, the batsman pushes it to long on for a single

Warner you beauty! This is sensational stuff. The batsman dabs it to midwicket and calls for a second.. This looked like a two.. but Warner hared in, swooped the ball and hit the stumps direct at non-striker's end.. Binny has to go back.. Binny is way way short..
direct hit and Smith was gone! Binny calls for a tight single to short third man.. Bhuvi misses
another slower delivery, the batsman punches it to deep cover for a single
slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman nudges it to midwicket softly and calls for a couple
tossed up delivery on off, the batsman drives it straight to Dhawan at cover
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes out of the crease and pushes it back at the bowler.. who fires it back at the keeper.. Binny has his head down.. he knows he edged it..
he comes forward and pushes this to long-on softly.. calls for a quick couple
this is the googly now and Binny has no clue.. It hits the top of his back pad..Superb delivery
another wicket! Loud appeal from the bowler and the keeper! That surely looked like a caught-behind.. I heard that edge in Mumbai.. Big Big edge.. as Binny went for the cut
comes out of the crease and plays the googly to the right of midwicket
slower delivery on the off, the batsman chops it straight to Pathan at short third man and sets off for a single
short ball, Binny goes for the pull but is late on the shot.. good for him as his shot falls well short of deep square leg
walks across to the off side and whips the length delivery to fine leg for a single
another slower delivery, the batsman chops it to point softly and calls for a single early
slower delivery on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep backward square leg for a couple
bowls it full and Binny plays a straight drive to be proud of, but hits the stumps at the non-striker's end
almost! The batsman comes out, is beaten by the flight, but manages to get some bat on it to push the ball to cover
charges down the pitch - he loves doing that - and punches this tossed up delivery to long on
tossed up delivery, the batsman comes out and almost yorks himself, manages to push this to deep cover
straighter one now, the batsman goes deep into his crease to punch this to deep cover
wonderful googly! Smith didn't see that coming but is lucky to get an inside edge on to his pads
tossed up delivery on off, the batsman comes forward to smother the spin with a defensive shot
tossed up delivery, pushed to mid-on with soft hands for a single
flatter and shorter, the batsman pushes it to midwicket with soft hands and comes back for a quick second
now Binny comes out of the crease to ease it to long on
comes out of the crease and drives this fuller delivery to long on
stumping chance gone abegging! Another superb ball, dips, and spins past the outside edge.. Smith was offbalance but the keeper misses it completely
tossed up on the pads, the batsman flicks it past short fine leg for a couple
floated up to the batsman, Smith pushes it to deep midwicket for a single
another good ball, the batsman looks to work it to the leg side, but gets a leading edge towards the bowler
loopy delivery, dips on the batsman as he comes out of the crease, Smith defends eventually
this one turns too much and is a wide down the leg side
super googly! turns in big time and hits the front pad.. but that hit him just outside the line of off.. Good ball
short enough for Binny to get back and punch it to deep cover
tossed up an full, Smith uses his feet and drives it to wide long-on
bowls the googly which is spotted by Smith, he works it away to deep midwicket playing with the turn
slower and loopy on off, the batsman drives it to deep cover for a single
he presses forward and defends the tossed up delivery
flatter and spins away after pitching, the batsman defends it to point
uses his feet and eases the tossed up delivery to long on
loopy delivery outside off, Smith comes forward and drives it to cover
waits on the back foot and defends the length delivery to cover
he shuffles across to the off side and clips the back of length delivery to fine leg
some energy in the field! Warner charges in from point to stop the defensive shot from Smith
big big wicket! The tide is turning in Sunrises' favour.. Loose shot from Watson as he tries to cut this short of length delivery, it was too close to cut really.. He gets a faint nick to the keeper
he comes forward and pushes the length delivery to mid-off
oh this is crisply timed through midwicket! Watson leans into this legside halfvolley and hits the gap
testing flighted delivery, Binny defends off the front foot

superb ball! Samson gives it away. It was tossed up on the off and middle, the drift brings it in, the loop draws Samson out of the crease.. But it doesn't turn, keeps going straight to hit the top of middle
that keeps coming in with the arm, Watson, who was playing back, gets an inside edge to short third man
flatter now, Samson is cool to push it to long-on for another easy single
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman eases it to long on for a single
flatter and on the pads, easily nudges away to deep square leg for a couple
just a punch to the off side, but this is expertly hit in the gap at cover, easy treble
stays calm and defends the back of length delivery to the leg side
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it solidly to cover
attempts a short delivery, but he has dug that in too short, sails way over the batsman's head
length delivery in the channel outside off, Watson comes forward before letting it go
confidently comes forward and punches this to wide mid-off for an easy single
gets one to come in to the batsman, Sanju pushes it calmly to mid-on
gets the wicket finally! Another back of length delivery swinging away from the batsman, the batsman pokes at it but only gets an outside edge to the keeper..
Nair has some timing too! This is back of length and offers some width, but Nair punches it superbly through point.. It flies past the fielder there
that's a quick short delivery.. he is no mug with the ball. Nair looks to pull but he is clearly in no position.. He is lucky that hasn't taken his head off
he is not bowling full anymore.. Nair defends this back of length delivery to point
short of length of off, the batsman dabs it to point for a single

whoa! This is superb! It was full on off, Samson didn't worry if it was swinging or not, he just lifts it over long-off with a straightest of bats.. That sails way beyond the boundary.. 146 kph that was bowled at.. Incredible shot
there comes the indipper but Nair is on task, brings his bat down stylishly to time this superbly through midwicket
slower delivery outside off, there is no hurry so Nair comes forward and defends
not much swing on this length delivery, Nair defends to point comfortably
this would have been game over for Nair! The batsman punched it to Karn Sharma at cover point and set off for a single straightaway.. Had Karn hit, Nair would have been out by a mile
another inswinger, Samson comes forward and drives it confidently to cover
length delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
poor line! This is on the pads and all Nair needs to do is get some bat on it.. He deflects it fine on the leg side for a boundary
he throws his bat at this outswinger again, but this flies off the thick outside edge.. not very far from third man
another superb delivery but Samson manages to get it away.. He chips it over mid-off and gets a boundary..not in complete control, but his aim for right
superb delivery! This one pitches just outside off and shapes away late, the batsman was looking to play the drive and misses it completely.. That is one of those Steyn specials
bowls it full on the offstump line, the batsman leans forward and drives it down to mid-off
starts off with a outswinger, left alone by the batsman

super inswinger this one! The height on that has saved the batsman..He didn't account for this much movement and was hit on the knee-roll right in front of the middle.. The replays show there was a huge inside edge on that too
looks to bring this one in from wide of the crease, the batsman comes on top of that nicely and guides it to third man
length delivery with some awayswing, the batsman leaves it alone
poor delivery to the new man! This is headed for the first slip almost.. The keeper gets there eventually
first wicket! This is a loose loose shot! He comes forward to this length delivery and pushes at it away from the body, giving a simple head-high catch to the point fielder
poor delivery, it's full and down the leg side.. luckily for the bowler it brushed the batsman's pad
bowls length just outside off, not much swing and whatever there is, Rahane covers it with a good front foot defensive prod
